## Context

The `Verify Authorship Identity` CI gate (`.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml`) enforces a
blobless-checkout pack-size budget via `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB`. The deliberate budget is
**100 MiB (102400 KiB)** — an intentional growth canary (commit `16a1a385`, ticket `037b`).

As part of epic `536b-8930-b922-4063` (causal-stability history reclaim), the budget was
**temporarily raised to 550 MiB (563200 KiB)** as a bridge, because the `tickets`-branch blobless
pack is ~481 MiB and safe causal-stability compaction alone cannot bring it under 100 MiB (proof
on 536b: even N=30d coalescing lands ~365-380 MiB). The bridge keeps the health lane green while
the reclaim mechanism (below-horizon commit/tree collapse) plus structural fixes W1 (batch write
lane) and W2 (shard the root tree) land.

## Scope of THIS ticket

This ticket tracks the **REVERSAL** of that bridge. It is a follow-up: once the 536b history
reclaim + W1/W2 have landed and the measured blobless pack is back under 100 MiB, restore
`REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` to `102400` and remove the bridge comment. This ticket stays open
until then; it is the durable, self-documenting reminder that the raised value is temporary.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The 536b history-reclaim swap has landed on the `tickets` remote and the measured blobless CI-checkout pack is verified under 100 MiB.
- [ ] `REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB` in `.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml` is restored to `102400`.
- [ ] The temporary-bridge comment referencing this ticket is removed from the workflow.
- [ ] The verify-identity gate passes green at the restored 100 MiB budget.

## Portability

The budget is a plain GitHub Actions workflow env var; restoring it is a one-line workflow edit
with no dependence on any single CI provider.
compiled_state.title: Restore verify-identity pack budget to 100 MiB after 536b history reclaim lands
